notes: LCMS parish on S Kolb Rd, Divine Service Sundays at 9am. Confirmed on 2026-09-10 from the church's own site: address 710 S Kolb Rd, Tucson AZ 85710 (site footer), LCMS affiliation (its 'Our Denomination' page points to the Lutheran Church - Missouri Synod), and Bill Hartley as Senior Pastor (staff page, where he is also listed as an elder and over discipleship). He is the only pastor on staff; the rest of the staff list is lay ministry directors, elders, shepherds and a board, so he appears to be the sole regular preacher, but the sermons page does not label speakers - confirm attribution from the videos themselves. Sermons are on YouTube: the channel UCdovNXbEU7aR-YG8F1UAEYA resolves to the handle @FountainofLifeTucson, and the church's /sermons page is just a series index (e.g. 'Sharpening the Acts II', 'Primer for the Reborn Life') linking to that channel. Note the church self-describes as 'committed to classical Christianity' and uses a contemporary-style series structure rather than strict lectionary titles, though the lectionary preaching caveat may still apply. WATCH OUT: there is a separate 'Fountain of Life Lutheran Church' in Sun City, Arizona with its own YouTube channels - make sure any videos pulled are from the Tucson channel. Coordinates remain the earlier grid estimate (geocode 'approximate') since the address did not change; re-run tools/geocode.py to upgrade them.
